revocation_reason: Peer review identified MLE optimizer convergence failure (Success: False, Iterations: 60). Production verdict is invalid when model fitting has not converged.

mle_convergence.implication: Team-specific attack/defense parameters did not converge. Model is effectively a global baseline with no team differentiation. All downstream probabilities, CLV, and ROI are unreliable.

gate_a_calibration.note: ECE/Brier may appear acceptable because a global-baseline Poisson with correct mu can still calibrate well on aggregate — but this does NOT prove the model has learned team-specific skill. Calibration without convergence is a necessary but not sufficient condition.

blocking_reasons: P0-01: MLE optimizer did not converge (Success: False). Team parameters are not fitted.
P0-02: 53% ROI requires leakage audit — no proof of absence of look-ahead bias.
P0-03: No timestamp proving odds were available before kickoff for each wager.
P0-04: Reverse strategy was selected AFTER seeing holdout results — holdout is no longer sacred.
P0-05: 1,176 wagers from ~296 unique matches (~3.97 per match) — correlation between markets not properly modeled.
P0-06: Match count discrepancy: header says 1,752 but actual holdout is 1,751.
P0-07: Forward strategy BLOCKED (-9.11% ROI) but pipeline still issued APPROVED for reverse — missing convergence guard.
P0-08: No walk-forward validation — single holdout season is insufficient.
P0-09: No multiple-testing correction for strategy selection.
P0-10: No independent reproduction of PnL from raw bet-level data.
P0-11: Notebook is not production architecture — no real-time ingestion, no circuit breaker, no monitoring.

governance_rationale: BLOCKED: Previous APPROVED_PRODUCTION verdict revoked. The Dixon-Coles MLE optimizer explicitly reported Success: False with 60 iterations. A pipeline that issues production approval on a non-converged model has a fundamental governance failure. All downstream metrics (CLV, ROI, PnL) are unreliable until convergence is proven. Additionally, 53% ROI requires independent leakage audit, walk-forward validation, and timestamp verification before any real-money consideration.
